messages.en:
{07 06 00}Oh no! You found me!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 16 00}Wow,
I'm no match for you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}
{07 14 00}And in exchange for seeing
the seeking master in
action...
I'm going to give you a
little present!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Oh ei! Sa leidsid mu!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 16 00}Vau,
ma pole sulle vastane,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}
{07 14 00}Ja vastutasuks selle eest,
et nägin otsimismeistrit
tegutsemas...
Ma annan sulle väikese
kingituse!
